Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000976": On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it.  (about: Atlas team, reports pipeline, retention change)
- memory_id "1000968" [decision]: As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, having taken it over from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, product catalog, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000962" [decision]: On 2025-12-19, the Atlas team took over the product catalog from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, product catalog, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000956" [decision]: On 2025-12-18, the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: Atlas team, indexer, index)
- memory_id "1000922": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and since it was not their service, they flagged it.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler, runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000917": The Boreal team observed on 2025-12-01 that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000852" [decision]: As of 2025-11-06, the feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000846": On 2025-11-04, the Ember team observed that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it.  (about: billing API, Ember team, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000841": The Boreal team observed on 2025-11-03 that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service, traffic shift)
- memory_id "1000811": On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000793" [constraint]: As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000772": As of 2025-09-30, the billing API depends on the feature flag service.  (about: billing API, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000767" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000662": The feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, most of them identical, as of 2025-09-02.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000658" [decision]: Clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, decided at the Atlas standup on 2025-09-02.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000554" [decision]: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000412": The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher, cache change)
- memory_id "1000384": The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000378": The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
